topics.topic: TypeScript's baseUrl option being deprecated in TS7
topics.angle: The tsconfig 'baseUrl' option almost every path-alias setup relies on is being phased out in TypeScript 7, so we show what actually breaks and the one-line fix.
topics.why: A Stack Overflow question on this hit 24,453 views, the single highest view count of any candidate this cycle, tagged typescript.

topics.angle: Postman now silently installs AI plugins and tries to pull in all your API data, while Milkman markets itself as the account-free, telemetry-free alternative that skips both.
topics.why: The Postman privacy issue is the top-scoring item across all candidates at 1,310 points/444 comments on Hacker News, and Milkman's own HN launch ('The Better Alternative to Postman') is a direct response to the same pain point.

topics.angle: Upgrading to Prisma 7 throws a cryptic '__internal' TypeError for a lot of people, and the real fix is a small config step most migration skims miss.
topics.why: Two separate Stack Overflow threads about Prisma v7 problems drew 5,942 and 2,182 views this cycle, on node.js and typescript tags respectively, showing the upgrade pain is widespread, not a one-off.

topics.topic: Claude Code isn't just for editing files
topics.angle: Claude Code can run real shell commands end to end, not just suggest diffs, which is exactly why people are pointing it at their Android TVs to strip out ad injections.
topics.why: A Claude-Code-themed short hit 409,645 views at 130x the channel's usual, the biggest outlier multiplier of any candidate, and two trending GitHub repos this same week target the same kind of on-device automation (android-ad-cleaner at 6,232 stars, Mika at 6,358 stars).

topics.angle: A clean Next.js app can start throwing 'Invalid source map' after an unrelated dependency bump, and the usual culprit is a sourceMappingURL nobody actually checks.
topics.why: This Stack Overflow question has 3,492 views on the next.js tag, with three different attempted answers and no clearly accepted fix.

topics.angle: Your Next.js OAuth login works locally but throws state_mismatch once deployed, because the state cookie isn't surviving the redirect the way you'd assume.
topics.why: This Stack Overflow question drew 2,131 views on the next.js tag specifically around Better Auth, and still had two different partial answers.

topics.topic: MongoDB Atlas SRV connection breaking after a Node upgrade
topics.angle: Switching Node versions can silently break your MongoDB Atlas connection string because Node changed how it resolves DNS, not because the URI is wrong.
topics.why: This Stack Overflow question has 2,047 views on the node.js tag, tied specifically to a Node version switch on Windows.

topics.angle: Most developers assume Zod's .email() matches what their backend considers valid, but its regex disagrees with plenty of real-world addresses.
topics.why: A dev.to comparison of 6 TypeScript validation libraries got 129 reactions and 54 comments this week, and a separate Stack Overflow question specifically about Zod email validation drew 855 views on the reactjs tag — two independent signals around the same library.

topics.angle: Safari 27.3 ships Adaptive Dark Mode, which rewrites light-only sites on the fly instead of waiting for developers to add a dark theme.
topics.why: WebKit's own announcement is sitting at 445 points and 231 comments on Hacker News this week, a shipped browser feature directly relevant to anyone styling a public site.

topics.angle: Figma is training a model fluent in its own file format and editing operations, aimed at AI agents that manipulate design files directly instead of just generating code from them.
topics.why: Figma's own blog post about this sits at 123 points on Hacker News this week, a release directly relevant to an audience already following AI coding tools.
